shared_elements: linear incised/engraved outline drawing on rock surface
justification: Both surfaces show human figures rendered as engraved outlines and include a small disc-like element, but A is a single stick-like figure with upraised arms beside a long undulating serpentine line, while B shows two clothed figures seated/kneeling facing each other across offerings with registers of script signs above and below. The relationships (offering scene between paired figures vs. isolated figure with a snake) and the proportions/detailing (schematic stick figure vs. detailed profile bodies with garments) are entirely different.
